name: challenger_policy_v1
written_before: any challenger forecast resolved (0 resolved at freezing time)

loss.rv: squared error of log(scored_value) vs log(outcome)

paired_with: champion M1_logistic, same origin and target

interim_futility.rule: RETIRE the challenger on a target if the 95% moving-block bootstrap CI (block 7 origins, 2000 draws, seed 0) of mean(loss_challenger - loss_champion) lies entirely above 0
interim_futility.checked: daily by the scheduler (job challenger_review); a retirement stops issuance for that target and is journaled as a decision outcome

promotion: unchanged (forecast protocol v1): >= 180 resolved per target, CI entirely below 0, human approval
no_other_stopping: no early stopping for success; no re-tuning after outcomes
